कब(ऋ)कबृ r. 1st cl. (कबते)
 1. To colour, to tinge with various hues.
2. To praise.

कबन्ध mn. (-न्धः-न्धं) A headless trunk, especially retaining vitality.
 n.
(-न्धं) Water.
 m. (-न्धः)
 1. A name of

. Also of a demon de-
stroyed by

. The belly.
 E. कं the head, and बध् to injure,
to lop, affix अच्; also कं water, and बन्ध binding, attaching.

कबन्धता f. (-ता) Headlessness, decapitation.
 E. कबन्ध and तल् affix; also
with त्व कबन्धत्वं.
कबित्थ m. (-त्थः) The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.

कबिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tawny, (of such a hue.)
 m. (-लः) Tawny (the
colour:) see कपिल.
